subject: general
question: 5 boys A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). No one is to the left of D. Only 3 boys are to the right of B. A is to the immediate left of E and immediate right of C. Who is to the immediate right of B?
solution:
Given: Five boys A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row facing north.

No one is to the left of D.

Only 3 boys are to the right of B.

A is to the immediate left of E and immediate right of C.s

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00ba9831060b870f8f9b82c148df798137782d98083fdc39801e43415b1d9805.png] 

Immediate right of B = C

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
